label: FortiSwitch 148F-FPOE 48-port switch, 48 PoE+ ports, 740 W
description: Fortinet FortiSwitch 148F-FPOE 1 RU Layer 2 PoE+ switch: 48x GE RJ45 all 802.3af/at PSE (740 W budget), 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, 176 Gbps switching capacity, 260 Mpps.

poe.note: 48 PoE ports, 740 W total. 740 W is 48 x 15.4 W (739.2 W): every port can run a Class 3 (802.3af) device, 24 can run a Class 4 (802.3at, 30 W) device, and 48 x 30 W = 1440 W is not available. Internal AC supply, 100-240 V, 893.5 W average / 895.7 W maximum consumption fully loaded - close to a 10 A circuit at 230 V.

fabric.note: Datasheet switching capacity 176 Gbps duplex with 260 Mpps: 48x 1G plus 4x 10G is 88 Gbit/s of line rate, doubled to 176 Gbps full duplex.

notes: Datasheet: 48x GE RJ45 and 4x 10GE SFP+; 48 (802.3af/at) PoE ports, 740 W budget; 176 Gbps switching capacity, 260 Mpps, 32 K MAC, <1 us latency, 4 K VLANs, 2 MB packet buffer, 512 MB DDR3, 64 MB flash, >10 years MTBF. 44 x 310 x 440 mm, 4.68 kg - the same chassis and weight as the 148F-POE, which differs only in how many ports are wired for power. Every copper port is a PSE port; the four SFP+ cages are not. FortiLink ports 45-52; SFP+ cages 49-52 (148F QuickStart Guide). Console RJ-45 at 115200 8-N-1 by default (https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortiswitch/7.6.5/enterprise-data-center-switching-with-evpn-vxlan-deployment-guide/313313/deployment-procedures), console IP 192.168.1.99. Layer 2 only - the FortiGate routes over FortiLink. PoE ceilings across this family are all af-multiples: 185 = 12 x 15.4, 370 = 24 x 15.4, 740 = 48 x 15.4, which is why the 30 W per-port ceiling is only available on a fraction of the ports at once.
